ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level dominance of low-intensity (black) pixels across the surface area with a secondary distribution of high-intensity (white) pixel clusters, creating a high-contrast speckled appearance.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense distribution of small, contiguous white circular blobs (approximate diameter 2-10 pixels) scattered across both lobes against a uniform dark background, with higher density clusters at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression dividing the lobes with a sharp, well-defined vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern with low-amplitude pixel oscillations (peaks and valleys) along the entire continuous linear boundary of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch extending to pointed, slightly hooked lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular high-contrast white pixel clusters across both fluke lobes, consistent with localized attachment scars.

other_distinctive_markers: The specific 'starry' density and spatial distribution of white mottling across an almost entirely black surface provides a unique visual identifier.
